# apple_app_info (Resource)

Sets an app's App Store categories. Changes apply to the app info of the version being prepared, and take effect when it is released; they need a version in an editable state. Destroying the resource leaves the categories as they are. Import it by app ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_info" "example" {
  app_id                  = data.apple_app.example.id
  primary_category        = "GAMES"
  primary_subcategory_one = "GAMES_PUZZLE"
  secondary_category      = "ENTERTAINMENT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Optional

- `primary_category` (String) Category ID, e.g. `GAMES` or `GAMES_PUZZLE`; see `apple_app_categories`.
- `primary_subcategory_one` (String) Category ID, e.g. `GAMES` or `GAMES_PUZZLE`; see `apple_app_categories`.
- `primary_subcategory_two` (String) Category ID, e.g. `GAMES` or `GAMES_PUZZLE`; see `apple_app_categories`.
- `secondary_category` (String) Category ID, e.g. `GAMES` or `GAMES_PUZZLE`; see `apple_app_categories`.
- `secondary_subcategory_one` (String) Category ID, e.g. `GAMES` or `GAMES_PUZZLE`; see `apple_app_categories`.
- `secondary_subcategory_two` (String) Category ID, e.g. `GAMES` or `GAMES_PUZZLE`; see `apple_app_categories`.

### Read-Only

- `app_info_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app info this reads, which changes with each version.
- `app_store_age_rating` (String) Age rating App Store Connect derived from the age rating declaration.
- `state` (String) State of that app info, e.g. `PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_info.example
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_info.example 1234567890
```
